metadata.sql:
WITH winner AS (
    SELECT finish_ms, driver_name, driver_code, constructor, year, grand_prix, position, grid, finish_time
    FROM v_race_results
    WHERE year = 2024
      AND ((lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
      AND position = 1
),
second_place AS (
    SELECT finish_ms
    FROM v_race_results
    WHERE year = 2024
      AND ((lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
      AND position = 2
)
SELECT 
    w.driver_name,
    w.driver_code,
    w.constructor,
    w.position,
    w.year,
    w.grand_prix,
    w.grid,
    w.finish_time,
    ROUND((p2.finish_ms - w.finish_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS winning_margin_s
FROM winner w
CROSS JOIN second_place p2
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2024 Brazilian Grand Prix and what was the winning margin over P2?
